The 12 exact historical blobs were recovered with git show and verified against
pre-existing pinned identities before use. provenance.json at the fixture root
records every original path, SHA-256, size and source commit. The same L50 evidence
also survives under LCProp-results/local/Research/a5-material-model-discriminator-sequence-v1/historical_L50/.
No remote access or diagnostic-map recomputation was used for recovery.

To recover elsewhere, extract the paths listed in provenance.json from that
preserved Research commit into the root above. Verify each SHA-256 before use.
Do not substitute similar artifacts. These are historical float32 saved spectrum
maps, not exact float64 production Analysis inputs. Original regression tolerances
and frozen diagnostic code are unchanged. Tests bind both comparison contracts,
coordinate bytes, map bytes, metrics bytes, shape, dtype and source definitions.
